title: Are You 'Most Done
author: Russell Owen
problems: Row 7 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 4 "star left 3 places 7/8 around til larks face next larks on diagonal" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "larks start a right diagonal full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
choices: A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
